method: Checked that src/09d_suite.js, 09_seats.js and 03_tex.js are unchanged from 623322c to HEAD 1430d42 (git diff --stat: only 04_shaders, 12_scene, 09b_py and 10_mono changed). Compared the w18 renders (ro/) with the head renders (rh/) at 930x575 for q02-q05. Used the side-by-side cmp_*.png images and signed luma-difference maps, saved as /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/1340cc88-268d-536d-9560-b1e2d4047e81/scratchpad/ra/d_<view>.png. Mean luma: q02 120.6->118.7, q03 146.3->140.8, q04 160.4->156.8, q05 167.7->163.8. Pixels with |dL|>8: 7 / 21 / 14 / 13 %, almost all of them sidewall, window and edge anti-aliasing. Sampled region means on suite surfaces: ottoman, shell, cap, wood, bed, console fascia. Compared them with the official refs f_17301 / 17304 / 17306 / 17313 and with 5 in-flight UpgradedPoints photos re-downloaded to cabin777/ref/web/suite/ (up_Empty, up_Doors, up_Bed-Made, up_Boarding, up_Privacy-Wall). No new Playwright renders: the suite geometry is byte-identical, so the earlier DPR 2 close-ups (w18a) still apply to geometry. Lighting is noted but not scored.

issues.problem: The caps read as a pale cream counter instead of a mid taupe-grey. In both real daylight and in-flight photos the cap is about half the sidewall's luminance; in the model it is close to the wall's value. The hue is right: B-R is -18 here, -11 in f_17313 and -19 in up_Empty. The material #8f8a76 (L~137, 0.59 of the sidewall material) is plausible, so most of the gap is top-lit horizontal faces plus the darker sidewall. The suite's overall value still reads lighter than the product.
issues.evidence: Rendered cap / wall: q05 cap 184,180,164 vs sidewall 199,204,214 (0.92); q02 near cap 187,184,169. Photos: f_17313 cap top (620-700, 170-200) 102,94,91 vs sidewall 226,228,227 (0.45); up_Empty cap 115,106,96 vs wall ~230 (0.5). The shell / cap ratio is fine (q02 107 / 185 = 0.58).
issues.fix: Joint suite + lighting: lower fCap to about #7d7868, or cut the top-down key on horizontal suite surfaces. Re-check that the cap still separates from the shell (f40 two-tone).

lighting_notes.problem: The sidewall around the suites went darker and blue-cool in this lighting loop, while the photos show it neutral and bright. It also pushes the cap / wall ratio (issue 1) further from the photos.
The q03 look-out is now almost clipped and the cloud detail is gone. This roughly matches f_17313, whose windows are blown white too, so it is acceptable.
Hard-edged sun parallelograms on the bed and the ottoman (unchanged). f_17304 and up_Bed-Made show soft, even light.
lighting_notes.evidence: q04 duvet sun patch 245,243,239 against shade 210,207,203, with sharp edges
